name: Dotflowy
install: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl -fsSL https://bun.com/install | bash -s "bun-v1.3.14"; export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run setup

terminals.name: cf:dev
terminals.description: Production-like single server: builds the SPA and serves it plus the Cloudflare Worker and per-user Durable Object on http://localhost:8787, rebuilding on src/ changes. Sign in with dev@dotflowy.local / dotflowy-dev (run `bun run seed:user` once if the account is missing).
